name: Wreckage & Salvage
description: Battles leave wrecks. Every destroyed ship or base drifts into a persistent debris field that decays over the years unless salvaged; construction and mining ships recover build resources and, sometimes, foreign technology from the wrecks. Pirates salvage too and raid harder around the big fields.

flags.name: wreckage
flags.label: Battle wreckage & salvage
flags.description: Destroyed ships and bases leave wrecks in debris fields; salvage missions (right-click a field with a construction or mining ship selected) recover resources and foreign tech; AI and pirate construction ships salvage nearby fields; pirate raids recover faster near big fields.
